cases.prompt: Use $explain-pr-changes. Neither gh nor glab is installed. This is the complete diff of PR acme/app#12, titled Include limit: file paging.ts, line 1 changes '-return items.slice(0, limit - 1);' to '+return items.slice(0, limit);'. Explain this small change using the supplied evidence only.
expectations: Explains that the slice now includes up to limit items rather than limit minus one
Uses the supplied diff without requiring a CLI
Returns a short explanation with accurate source references

cases.prompt: Explain PR acme/app#14 from this excerpt only. auth.ts changes a session guard to require an active session; the other three changed files are unavailable. No network access is available.
expectations: States that the remaining files and full PR behavior were not inspected
forbidden: Blocks all explanation despite available evidence
